change: Bounded shared storage for instruction-to-web links and first live-range segments; omit inspection-map construction for optimizer callers that need only ranges; remove an unused position map. Dataflow equations, ranges and public Liveness maps are unchanged.
measurement_source: Frozen baseline at base_commit and candidate at that base plus this commit's six production-file changes. The same new Liveness benchmark fixture was added before both builds. Subsequent branch integrations are outside the measurements.
scope: Compiler analysis and compression-only native emission; no C compilation, linking or application execution. No runtime-speed claim: generated native object and C companion are byte-identical in all four emissions.

platform.limitations: Shared host with uncontrolled frequency and scheduling; load recorded per run. No builds or tests from this experiment overlapped measurements. Timings are observations without confidence intervals or a general wall-clock multiplier.

profile_basis.workload: BenchmarkSimplifyCopies, 50 iterations before edits, CPU and heap profiles enabled
profile_basis.interpretation: About 30% of sampled allocation objects came from Liveness, chiefly instruction-link slices and segment appends; this is a sampled attribution, not an exact allocation count.

microbenchmarks.initial_protocol: Before/after/after/before, five samples of three iterations per fixture per invocation. Simplify clones and lifts 128 copies and verifies propagation/removal counts. Liveness excludes Lift/Webs and retains the public inspection-map work. The short 64-block timing was slower after the change, so all Liveness shapes were rerun for longer.
